source.check: returned unopposed: sole nomination (page image, Newry Reporter, 7 May 1936, p. 5); the only contests were Carrickcrossan and the two Rathfriland divisions (Frontier Sentinel, 16 May 1936, p. 5); present at the new council's annual meeting (Newry Reporter, 13 June 1936, p. 3)

note: Triennial rural district council election, Newry No. 1 (County Down), fourteen divisions. Polling took place on Thursday 4 June 1936 in the three contested divisions (Carrickcrossan, Rathfriland North, Rathfriland South); four divisions had a single nomination and in seven no nomination was made, the sitting member continuing (Newry Reporter, 7 May 1936, p. 5). James Malone, the sitting member, did not seek re-election. Returned unopposed.
